visceral.config.title: Visceral Settings
visceral.option.shoulder_camera.tooltip: Replace third-person view (F5) with a smoothed over-the-shoulder camera.
visceral.option.decoupled_camera.tooltip: The mouse orbits the camera; your character turns to face where you move (GTA style).
visceral.option.shoulder_offset.tooltip: Sideways offset of the camera. Swap shoulders with the Swap Shoulder key.
visceral.option.camera_smoothing.tooltip: How softly the camera follows. Lower values reduce motion lag.
visceral.option.camera_sensitivity.toolt: Mouse sensitivity multiplier for the free camera.
visceral.option.camera_shake.tooltip: Camera shake from hits and impacts. Set to 0% if prone to motion sickness.
visceral.option.aim_convergence.tooltip: Aim projectiles and interactions at whatever is under the crosshair.
visceral.option.auto_shoulder_swap.toolt: Swap shoulders automatically when a wall blocks the view.
visceral.option.movement_inertia.tooltip: Acceleration/deceleration momentum. 0% is vanilla's instant movement.
visceral.option.turn_speed.tooltip: How fast the character turns towards your movement direction with the free camera.
visceral.option.lock_on_range.tooltip: Maximum distance for acquiring a lock-on target.
visceral.option.animation_overhaul.toolt: Procedural locomotion, leaning, weight shift and combat animations.
visceral.option.animate_players.tooltip: Apply the animation overhaul to players.
visceral.option.animate_mobs.tooltip: Apply the animation overhaul to humanoid mobs.
visceral.option.animation_intensity.tool: Scales leaning, sway and flinch amplitude.
visceral.option.hit_reactions.tooltip: Spring-driven flinches when bodies are struck.
visceral.option.hit_stop.tooltip: Momentary freeze-frame on heavy impacts for weight.
visceral.option.death_ragdolls.tooltip: Bodies go limp and fall with physics when killed.
visceral.option.active_behaviours.toolti: Protective reflexes, bracing, struggling and push-up attempts on ragdolls.
visceral.option.muscle_strength.tooltip: Strength of active ragdoll muscles (0% = fully limp).
visceral.option.ragdoll_gravity.tooltip: Gravity for ragdoll physics (Minecraft entities fall at about 32).
visceral.option.corpse_seconds.tooltip: How long dead bodies remain before sinking away.
visceral.option.blood_amount.tooltip: Scales the number of blood particles.
visceral.option.blood_decals.tooltip: Persistent splatters and pools on surfaces.
visceral.option.max_ragdolls.tooltip: Ragdolls beyond this limit are frozen in place.
visceral.option.ragdoll_substeps.tooltip: Solver substeps per physics step. Higher is more stable but costs more CPU.
visceral.option.max_decals.tooltip: Oldest blood decals are removed first.
visceral.option.animation_distance.toolt: Beyond this distance entities use vanilla animation.
visceral.option.ragdoll_distance.tooltip: Beyond this distance ragdolls stop simulating.
visceral.option.melee_overhaul.tooltip: Timed weapon swings, combos, kicks and finishers (server).
visceral.option.mob_windups.tooltip: Mobs telegraph melee attacks; kick or hit them to interrupt (server).
visceral.option.knockdowns_players.toolt: Players can be staggered and knocked down too (server).
visceral.option.finishers.tooltip: Contextual finishing moves on downed or staggered enemies (server).
visceral.option.crawling.tooltip: Crippled mobs crawl after you instead of getting up (server).
visceral.option.bleeding.tooltip: Deep cuts and stabs bleed for damage over time (server).
visceral.option.wound_effects.tooltip: Leg wounds slow, arm wounds weaken attacks (server).
visceral.option.knockdown_threshold.tool: Force needed to knock an average humanoid down (server).
visceral.option.max_gore_server.tooltip: Maximum gore level allowed for all players (server).
